title: Uncategorized stays on the General Matrix after the release
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Use a staging client on which nobody has set up tiers or changed a matrix since the release: its Tiers list shows only Default and the Audit Log of its Matrices list shows no event.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Uncategorized is listed with General Matrix as its matrix.
  • Uncategorized carries the Default badge.

Step 2:

  • Uncategorized's page names General Matrix as its matrix.
  • Its name cannot be changed: no rename control is offered, while its matrix is shown.
